newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia, Vietnam refine tax agreement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia, Vietnam refine tax agreement.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Friday the Australia-Vietnam Double Tax Agreement had been amended to provide tax concessions for Australians investing in Vietnam.
Under the new arrangements, an Australian investor taking advantage of specified Vietnamese tax concessions is deemed to have the paid tax actually foregone by Vietnam, Costello said.
Without the change, Vietnam would have been unable to grant a tax concession to an Australian investor without Canberra negating it by topping up the tax liability back in Australia.
But Costello said the tax sparing arrangement would not be available for banking, insurance, consulting, accounting, auditing and commercial services.
Shipping and aircraft operations would only receive the benefit to a limited extent.
A bill containing the changes would be entered into parliament as soon as possible, Costello said in a statement.
